hard_invariants: 8 Required Brew Fields: bean_name, bean_weight_g, grind_setting, grinder_type (independent vs built-in), grinder_model, brew_method (Espresso vs Cold Brew), yield_g, extraction_time_s, pressure_bar.
Camera Persistent STA Mode: DJI DUML v1 [CmdSet=0x07, CmdId=0x47] switches Pocket 3 / Pocket 4 Pro from AP (192.168.2.1) to persistent Home LAN STA mode.
On-Camera Internal Daemon: /data/local/tmp/pocket_sta_agent.sh keeps wpa_supplicant alive, disables wlan0 power_save, exposes DCIM on :8088, and webhooks /api/camera/webhook on MP4 completion.
Zero-Intervention Voice Pipeline: Wake phrase '我要开始制作咖啡' triggers DUML [02:02] start; stop phrase '制作完成' or silence stops recording, runs AI analysis, and pushes mobile alert.
Missing Parameter Loop: Any missing required field marks status='needs_info' and sends interactive supplement link to WeCom/ServerChan/Bark/Mobile UI.
Lossless Context Compaction: SessionContextCompactor preserves provenance + revision history for self-corrections while compressing raw transcripts.
